original_requirement: The packing score reads two byte quantities before calculation and returns twice the first plus three times the second as UInt16BE. Author a reusable doubling definition and a tripling definition that composes doubling and adds its input once more. The program must compose both pinned definitions. Reject scores above 1000 as SCORE at the first byte, before trailing-data rejection. Exactly two bytes are required.
